---
title: "drivetime"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(nflverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
pbp = load_pbp(2025)
```

```{r}
#drives = pbp |>
#  select(game_id,game_half,game_seconds_remaining,qtr,drive,quarter_seconds_remaining,half_seconds_remaining,quarter_end,drive_time_of_possession,time,play_type_nfl,play,play,play_id,desc,drive_ended_with_score,drive_play_count)

pbp_1 = pbp |>
  filter(play_id != 1) |>
  group_by(game_id, game_half) |>
  mutate(
    time_elapsed = game_seconds_remaining - lead(game_seconds_remaining),
    time_elapsed = if_else(quarter_end == 1 | time_elapsed < 0, NA_real_, time_elapsed
  )) |>
  ungroup() |>
  
  
  
  #creates summary drive variables
  group_by(game_id, fixed_drive) |>
  mutate(
    qb_kneels = sum(qb_kneel), 
    drive_top_after_play = cumsum(coalesce(time_elapsed, 0)),
    drive_play_num = cumsum(play_type_nfl %in% c("PASS","RUSH","FIELD_GOAL","SACK")),
    drive_first_downs = sum(first_down,na.rm = TRUE),
    drive_rush_attempts = sum(rush_attempt,na.rm = TRUE),
    drive_rushing_yards = sum(rushing_yards,na.rm = TRUE),
    drive_pass_attempts = sum(pass_attempt,na.rm = TRUE),
    drive_pass_yards = sum(passing_yards,na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

```

```{r}

#create a table for only plays that end drivs

end_of_drive_plays = pbp_1 |>
  filter(season_type=="REG") |>
  slice_tail(n=1,by=c(game_id,fixed_drive))

```

```{r}
total_drives <- pbp |>
  filter(season_type == "REG", !is.na(fixed_drive)) |>
  distinct(game_id, fixed_drive) |>
  nrow()

total_drives
```
